mail/smtp_reply#

SMTP replies (RFC 5321 §4.2): a code and lines of text.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let reply = SmtpReply(code: 250, lines: ["mail.example.test", "PIPELINING", "SIZE 35882577"]);
reply.bytes();                         // "250-mail.example.test\r\n250-PIPELINING\r\n250 SIZE…"
let decoder = SmtpReplyDecoder().fed(chunk);
if decoder.complete() { decoder.reply(); }

Description#

SMTP replies (RFC 5321 §4.2): a code and lines of text.

Replies are ASCII and bounded: 512 bytes per line, 100 lines and 64 KiB by default. The decoder takes chunks as they arrive and stops at the final line; finish() says when the input ended too early.
